row.title: REPO-CONFORM-2: the six tenant conformance exceptions are removed once the fleet reads 12 of 12
row.body: Every tenant repository's own pull request merged and python3 seed/scripts/repoconform.py --fleet doctrine/fleet-map.json reads 12 of 12 repositories conforming from GitHub. The dated conformance-pending exceptions in doctrine/tenant-standard.json held findings only until those pull requests landed, so they are removed; the Q-CONFORM items close by their own probe on the daily queue pass.
